title: UI风格#107 - Irish Pub (爱尔兰酒吧)
description: 创建第107种UI风格：爱尔兰酒吧风格 - 精酿啤酒、壁炉火焰、老式木屋。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDC.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub style When color palette Then features stout brown, amber ale, cream foam, turf fire
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#3C1414 (烈性黑啤), #D4A574 (麦芽), #FFF8DC (泡沫), #8B4513 (泥炭火), #228B22 (爱尔兰绿)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub style When typography Then uses rustic fonts: Lora, Merriweather, or Bitter
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Lora (标题), Merriweather (正文), Bitter (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub style When layout Then wood paneling, beer taps, fireplace glow, shamrock accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：木质镶板、啤酒龙头、壁炉火光、三叶草点缀

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub style When UI elements Then beer pour animation, fire flicker, wood grain texture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：啤酒倾倒动画、火焰闪烁、木纹质感、泡沫升腾

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub UI When functional Then includes pub chat, brewer agents, pint stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：酒吧聊天、酿酒师代理、酒杯统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Irish Pub UI When copy Then uses pub language: 'Pint', 'Pour', 'Cask', 'Brew'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'PINT. POUR. CASKS.'、按钮'SEND'→'ORDER'、'SUBMIT'→'BREW'
